elements.name: set_logger
elements.brief: Customize the logging mechanism used by Panthera Runtime. You can use Defold Log library or provide a custom logger.
elements.description: Customize the logging mechanism used by Panthera Runtime. You can use Defold Log library or provide a custom logger.

parameters.name: logger_instance
parameters.doc: A logger object that follows the specified logging interface. Pass nil to use empty logger

elements.name: create_go

elements.description: Load and create a game object animation state from a Lua table or JSON file.

parameters.doc: Lua table with animation data or path to JSON animation file in custom resources

parameters.name: collection_name
parameters.doc: Collection name to load nodes from. Pass nil if no collection is used

parameters.name: objects
parameters.doc: Table with game objects from collectionfactory. Pass nil if no objects are used

elements.name: create_gui
elements.brief: Load and create a GUI animation state from a Lua table or JSON file.

parameters.name: animation_or_path
parameters.doc: Lua table with animation data or path to JSON animation file in custom resources

parameters.name: template
parameters.doc: The GUI template ID to load nodes from. Pass nil if no template is used

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.doc: Table with nodes from gui.clone_tree() function. Pass nil if no nodes are used

elements.name: create
elements.brief: Load an animation from a Lua table or JSON file and create an animation state using a specified adapter.
elements.description: Load an animation from a Lua table or JSON file and create an animation state using a specified adapter.

parameters.name: animation_or_path
parameters.doc: Lua table with animation data or path to JSON animation file in custom resources

parameters.name: adapter
parameters.doc: An adapter object that specifies how Panthera Runtime interacts with Engine

parameters.name: get_node
parameters.doc: Function to get node by node_id. A custom function to resolve nodes by their ID

elements.name: clone_state
elements.brief: Clone an existing animation state object, enabling multiple instances of the same animation to play simultaneously or independently.
elements.description: Clone an existing animation state object, enabling multiple instances of the same animation to play simultaneously or independently.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object to clone

returnvalues.doc: New animation state object that is a copy of the original

elements.name: play
elements.brief:
Play an animation with specified ID and options.
One timer drives the whole tree, each tick finishes the running clips before starting new ones.
elements.description:
Play an animation with specified ID and options.
One timer drives the whole tree, each tick finishes the running clips before starting new ones.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object returned by `create_go` or `create_gui`

parameters.name: animation_id
parameters.doc: The ID of the animation to play

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Options for the animation playback

elements.name: play_tweener
elements.brief: Play animation with easing support using tweener. Allows for non-linear animation playback with custom easing functions.
elements.description: Play animation with easing support using tweener. Allows for non-linear animation playback with custom easing functions.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object

parameters.name: animation_id
parameters.doc: The ID of the animation to play

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Options including easing function, speed, and callbacks

elements.name: play_detached
elements.brief:
Play animation as a child of the current animation state, allowing multiple animations to run independently and simultaneously.

This creates a detached animation that runs in parallel with the main animation state without affecting it.
The child animation will be automatically cleaned up when it completes.
elements.description:
Play animation as a child of the current animation state, allowing multiple animations to run independently and simultaneously.

This creates a detached animation that runs in parallel with the main animation state without affecting it.
The child animation will be automatically cleaned up when it completes.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The parent animation state object

parameters.name: animation_id
parameters.doc: The ID of the animation to play as a detached child

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Options for the detached animation playback

elements.name: set_time
elements.brief: Set the current time of an animation. This function stops any currently playing animation.
elements.description: Set the current time of an animation. This function stops any currently playing animation.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object returned by `create_go` or `create_gui`.

parameters.name: animation_id
parameters.doc: The ID of the animation to modify.

parameters.name: time
parameters.doc: The target time in seconds to which the animation should be set.

parameters.name: event_callback
types: ((event_id: string, node: Opaque<"node"> | undefined, string_value: string, number_value: number) => void) | undefined

returnvalues.doc: True if animation state was set successfully, false if animation can't be set

elements.name: get_time
elements.brief: Retrieve the current playback time in seconds of an animation. If the animation is not playing, the function returns 0.
elements.description: Retrieve the current playback time in seconds of an animation. If the animation is not playing, the function returns 0.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object

elements.name: stop
elements.brief: Stop a currently playing animation. The animation will be stopped at current time.
elements.description: Stop a currently playing animation. The animation will be stopped at current time.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object to stop

returnvalues.doc: True if animation was stopped, false if animation is not playing

elements.name: get_duration
elements.brief: Retrieve the total duration of a specific animation.
elements.description: Retrieve the total duration of a specific animation.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object

parameters.name: animation_id
parameters.doc: The ID of the animation whose duration you want to retrieve

returnvalues.doc: The total duration of the animation in seconds

elements.name: is_playing
elements.brief: Check if an animation is currently playing.
elements.description: Check if an animation is currently playing.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object

returnvalues.doc: True if the animation is currently playing, false otherwise

elements.name: get_latest_animation_id
elements.brief: Get the ID of the last animation that was started.
elements.description: Get the ID of the last animation that was started.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object

returnvalues.doc: Animation ID or nil if no animation was started

elements.name: get_animations
elements.brief: Return a list of animation IDs from the created animation state.
elements.description: Return a list of animation IDs from the created animation state.

parameters.name: animation_state
parameters.doc: The animation state object

returnvalues.doc: Array of animation IDs available in the animation state

elements.name: reload_animation
elements.brief:
Reload animations from JSON files, useful for development and debugging.

The animations loaded from Lua tables will not be reloaded.
Animation will be reloaded only at desktop.
elements.description:
Reload animations from JSON files, useful for development and debugging.

The animations loaded from Lua tables will not be reloaded.
Animation will be reloaded only at desktop.

parameters.name: animation_path
parameters.doc: Specific animation to reload. If omitted, all loaded animations are reloaded
